features.name: Oath Spells & Tenets
features.description:
**Oath of the Elements Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | burning hands, thunderwave |
| 5th | acid arrow, flaming sphere |
| 9th | call lightning, protection from energy |
| 13th | conjure minor elementals, ice storm |
| 17th | conjure elemental, wall of stone |

**Tenets:** Defend the Natural World. Lead the Line. Act Wisely, Act Decisively. Integrity.

features.name: Elemental Language
features.description: When you take this oath at 3rd level, you learn to speak, read, and write Primordial.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Abjure the Otherworldly.** As an action, present your holy symbol. Each elemental or fiend within 30 ft that can see or hear you must make a WIS save or be turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

**Elemental Strike.** As a bonus action, imbue one held weapon with elemental power. Choose air, earth, fire, or water. For 1 minute, gain CHA modifier bonus (min +1) to damage with that weapon. Damage type: lightning or thunder (air), acid (earth), fire (fire), cold (water). While imbued, you can use this damage type instead of radiant on Divine Smite.

features.name: Aura of Resistance
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder when you finish a short or long rest. You and friendly creatures within 10 ft have resistance to that damage type. At 18th level, range increases to 30 ft.

features.name: Elemental Companion
features.description: At 15th level, as an action, summon a friendly elemental of CR 2 or lower in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. It obeys verbal commands, has its own initiative, and defends itself if given no commands. Only one at a time; disappears if you summon another or it drops to 0 HP. Dismiss as bonus action. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Elemental Companion
payload.description: Summon a CR 2 or lower friendly elemental within 30 ft. Obeys commands. Dismiss as bonus action.

features.name: Elemental Champion
features.description:
At 20th level, as a bonus action, manifest elemental power for 1 minute:

* Choose one: fly speed 90 ft (hover) like air elemental, Earth Glide + burrow 30 ft like earth elemental, or swim speed 90 ft like water elemental.
* Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage.
* Imbue your weapon with 3d6 extra elemental damage (type per element: lightning/thunder for air, acid for earth, fire for fire, cold for water). Can use this type instead of radiant on Divine Smite.

1/long rest.

payload.name: Elemental Champion
payload.description: For 1 min: elemental movement (fly 90 / burrow 30 / swim 90), resistance to all elemental damage, weapon deals +3d6 elemental damage.
